players.name: Travis Hunter
players.note: Jaguars' 2026 depth chart lists him as backup WR behind Brian Thomas Jr with CB as his primary starting role, a deliberate load-management plan after November knee (LCL) surgery, capping his offensive snaps regardless of talent.

players.name: Tank Bigsby
players.note: Traded to Philadelphia in Sept 2025; firmly the backup on a strong offense and elite line, but touches are scarce (58 carries in 16 games) behind a durable Barkley, so upside is capped unless Barkley misses time.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Behind bell-cow Pollard in a rebuilding Titans offense; ankle IR stint opened 2025 and joins a run of concussion/hamstring/ankle absences in 2024, though new OC Daboll could expand his passing-game role if Pollard's workload slips.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: QB1 in a top-10 offense throwing to a stacked WR room (JSN, Kupp, Shaheed), but a late-2025 oblique injury and journeyman durability history cap games, and at 29 in a settled role there's little room above the projection.

players.name: Tyler Shough
players.note: Saints offense was bottom-tier in Kellen Moore's first year and remains a rebuild; Olave is a legitimate WR1 but has a blood-clot/concussion history and top rookie target Jordyn Tyson is out ~2 months with a hamstring injury, leaving a thin WR2 group; Shough himself has a notable injury history (multiple major college injuries) even though he stayed healthy in his 9-game 2025 stint as starter.

players.name: Jayden Higgins
players.note: Tore his ACL in mid-August 2026 joint practice and was placed on season-ending IR, wiping out what would have been a strong WR2-behind-Collins/Stroud opportunity.

players.name: Isiah Pacheco
players.note: Signed with Detroit as clear RB2 behind Gibbs on an elite offense and O-line, but touch share is capped by Gibbs' workhorse role; current camp MCL sprain plus a 2024 fractured fibula keep his games projection down, with modest upside only if Gibbs misses time.

players.name: Cyrus Allen
players.note: Fifth-round rookie beating out Remigio and Royals for the WR4 job behind Rice/Worthy/Kelce in a Mahomes-led offense, so target share is capped short-term; a shin injury interrupted camp and rookie WR4 role usage makes his games/snaps this year uncertain, but strong camp buzz and crowded-but-injury-prone group ahead of him give real room to grow into more.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.note: Only just returned to full-pads practice in August 2026 after ACL/MCL/PCL reconstruction from Dec 2024, so a Week 1 return and workload are both uncertain even though Higgins' IR stint clears a path to targets behind Stroud/Collins.

players.name: Omar Cooper
players.note: Geno Smith is a fine but unspectacular starter and the Jets offense was bottom-half in 2025 with turnover at OC/QB; Cooper enters camp as WR4 behind Garrett Wilson, Adonai Mitchell and Isaiah Williams, capping his target share despite solid spring reps.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.note: Firmly RB2 behind Judkins on a middling-to-weak Cleveland offense, but Judkins is coming off a fractured fibula/dislocated ankle and is already dealing with a nagging issue in camp, giving Sampson real touch upside as the young pass-catching change-of-pace back if that recurs.

players.name: Fernando Mendoza
players.note: No.1 overall rookie but Raiders opened camp with Cousins as starter and Mendoza confirmed QB2 on the first depth chart, so he's a backup with no clear 2026 starting path barring injury.

players.name: MarShawn Lloyd
players.note: Buried behind Jacobs on a decent GB offense, but recurring hamstring/ACL-related injuries have cost him time in each of his first two years (IR again in 2025); Jacobs' shaky contract status and off-field issues give Lloyd a real path to a bigger role if healthy.

players.name: Kaelon Black
players.note: Third-round rookie who has climbed to clear RB2 in Shanahan's efficient offense, but stuck behind CMC's every-down role until McCaffrey's well-documented injury history opens a window.

players.name: Malik Washington
players.note: Waddle and Hill are both gone and Tua was released, so Washington is now the clear WR1 target for unproven starter Malik Willis in a rebuilding passing game with only soft competition (Tolbert, Atwell, rookies) behind him.

players.name: AJ Barner
players.note: Reigning Super Bowl champ offense with Darnold playing well, but heavy target competition from JSN, Kupp, Shaheed and a rising TE2 (Elijah Arroyo) caps his ceiling despite holding the TE1 depth-chart spot.

players.name: Chig Okonkwo
players.note: Signed as WAS's clear TE1 in a good offense when Jayden Daniels is healthy, but he's the third read behind McLaurin and Deebo Samuel and Daniels missed 10 games in 2025 to injury, capping the ceiling.

players.name: Juwan Johnson
players.note: Saints offense is mid-tier and unproven under second-year QB Tyler Shough; Chris Olave is a 100-catch target hog and new TE depth (Noah Fant, rookie Oscar Delp) caps further growth for a 29-year-old already at his ceiling after a career-best 77-catch season.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Rookie 3rd-rounder buried at WR4/slot behind London, Dotson and Zaccheaus with a QB situation clouded by Penix's ACL recovery; a return-man role and camp buzz give modest upside but no clear path to targets yet.

players.name: Jerry Jeudy
players.note: Clear WR1 in a bottom-tier offense throwing to a QB room led by Watson coming off Achilles surgery with rookie Sanders behind him, and a crowded young WR/TE room (Concepcion, Fannin, Boston) caps the ceiling despite volume.

players.name: Dalton Schultz
players.note: Clear starting TE catching from a healthy Stroud, and Jayden Higgins' season-ending ACL tear thins the WR room further, funneling more looks his way after a career-high 106-target 2025; offense itself is unproven with a retooled line and receiver corps.

players.name: Tre Tucker
players.note: Raiders traded Geno Smith and now run Cousins/rookie Mendoza behind a bottom-tier offense, and Tucker is the clear WR2 behind newly-paid Nailor with Bech, Thornton, Bowers and Jeanty all pulling targets.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: Confirmed 2026 starter after a $67.5M deal, but throws to what PFF calls the worst receiving corps in football post-Hill/Waddle/Waller with a shaky right guard; Achane keeps the offense from bottoming out and Willis's rushing ability gives modest upside despite just 209 career dropbacks.

players.name: Braelon Allen
players.note: Bottom-tier Jets passing offense with Justin Fields, and Allen is stuck in a three-way committee behind newly re-signed Breece Hall and ascending Isaiah Davis; still recovering from a season-ending Week 4 knee injury in 2025, but his path to a bigger early-down/TD role opens up fast if the injury-prone Hall misses time again.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: Buried as RB3 behind newly-signed Kenneth Walker III and Emari Demercado in a Mahomes-led but recently uneven offense, so touches are scarce absent an injury ahead of him.
